name: Adult Brass Dragon
summary: A huge metallic dragon that breathes fire or sleep-inducing gas and takes legendary actions.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance
traits.text: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The dragon makes three Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of (A) Sleep Breath or (B) Spellcasting to cast *{ref:spell/scorching-ray}*.

actions.name: Sleep Breath
actions.onFailure: The target has the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn, at which point it repeats the save. *Second Failure:* The target has the Unconscious condition for 10 minutes. This effect ends for the target if it takes damage or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to wake it.

atWill.note: Beast or Humanoid form only, no Temporary Hit Points gained from the spell, and no Concentration or Temporary Hit Points required to maintain the spell

legendaryActions.intro: Immediately after another creature's turn, the dragon can expend a use to take one of the following actions. The dragon regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.

items.name: Blazing Light
items.text: The dragon uses Spellcasting to cast *{ref:spell/scorching-ray}*.

items.name: Pounce
items.text: The dragon moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one Rend attack.

items.name: Scorching Sands

save.targets: one creature the dragon can see within 120 feet

items.onFailure: and the target's Speed is halved until the end of its next turn.
items.onFailureOrSuccess: The dragon can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.
